item.blurb: MixRoom Raises Seed Funding from MYSC. MixRoom, a music-tech startup, has secured seed funding from MYSC to advance its AI-powered cloud-based digital audio workstation software.
IPX Exchange Raises $4M Seed. IPX Exchange raises $4M seed round at a $125M valuation to build an agentic operating system and tokenized exchange for intellectual property on Base.
Sprout Family Raises $3.55M CAD Seed. Sprout Family raises $3.55M CAD in an oversubscribed seed round led by BDC Thrive Venture Fund to expand its integrated family benefits platform.
Sharp Performance Raises $18M Series A. Sharp Performance raises $18M Series A led by Hidden Variable to expand its coaching and training marketplace for first responders.
Chariot Raises $10M Series A. Chariot raises $10M Series A round led by Silverton Partners to scale its AI-driven legal tech platform for mass consumer arbitration claims.

Confido Health Raises $12.5M Series A Extension. Confido Health raises $12.5M in a Series A extension round led by Z47 to expand its AI-driven administrative automation platform for healthcare providers.

RapidCanvas Raises $29M Series B. RapidCanvas raises $29M in a Series B round led by Vertex Ventures to expand its enterprise AI platform and grow engineering teams globally.
Stand Raises $70M Series C. Stand raises $70 million in a Series C funding round led by Saga Ventures to scale its property-resilience insurance platform and digital modeling technology.
Sirona Medical Raises $40M Series D. Sirona Medical raises $40M in a Series D round led by Avidity Partners to scale its cloud-native radiology operating system and AI-driven workflow platform.

Goodweek Raises $12M in Funding. Goodweek raises $12 million in a funding round led by Adara Ventures to scale its AI management platform for small and medium-sized businesses.
